subject: [Commercial ask] compensation for prefetch/KV delay impacting go-live
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial ask: compensation for prefetch/KV delay impacting Montclair go-live

Team — quick background: Montclair Health (DEAL-8291) was scheduled to go live with our private deployment + ded. capacity next week for their triage assistant. During the final integration sprint they hit a prefetch/KV regression that increases average request latency and token cost per request for their high-throughput flow. Engineering (karthik) has identified the root cause as a kernel-selection path regression for the recent runtime release; mitigation is scheduled but will arrive on a 1.0.3 patch that won’t be in their environment until 9/7 due to their change freeze.

Customer impact: delays to go-live and materially higher cost for the first month of traffic. Procurement is pushing back and asking for a commercial remedy (credits) to keep their launch schedule. They also asked for a timeline and an explicit rollback/fallback plan. I attached the integration notes and a snapshot of their timeline.

Ask: approval to offer a one-month usage credit capped at $45k (or up to 20% of their committed month, whichever is lower) contingent on the patch ETA and an agreed mutual action plan. I want to propose this as an exec-sanctioned accommodation rather than a full repricing. Can you weigh in on feasibility and suggested language for a credit memo?

Next steps I’ll need:
- Product: confirm patch ETA and risk of recurrence (karthik)
- Sales: confirm commercial band and whether $45k is within delegation (laura)
- Finance/RevOps: quick sanity check on precedent (aditya)

Thanks — Maya

--
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

[Attachment: timeline_snapshot.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial ask: compensation for prefetch/KV delay impacting Montclair go-live

Thanks Maya — short answers:
- Root cause: an optimization in the kernel selector that misclassifies some KV cache hit patterns when request prefix lengths vary widely. It increases per-token work for batched flows; reproducible in our lab but not caught in standard perf harness for that SKU.
- Fix ETA: code fix merged; QA + perf validation run is in progress. Assuming no surprises, we can build/promote on 2026-08-31 and provide a staged patch starting 2026-09-02; customer rollout depends on their change freeze and testing window — your 9/7 date looks right.
- Workaround: temporary policy to force legacy kernel selection per-model is possible for their dedicated pool; we can prepare an ops script to toggle it if they want an earlier relief, but it increases CPU utilization ~8-12% and would need explicit approval from the infra team.

On recurrence risk: low once patched; the case is a narrow edge in prefix distributions. I’ll prepare a short technical note we can share with Montclair and Ops.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Runtime

Please route the final language through Legal and RevOps. I’ll draft a short memo we can use as an internal approval note.
